item.description:
**Download:** [Leise-2.3.0.zip](https://github.com/ramonfeng/leise/releases/download/v2.3.0/Leise-2.3.0.zip) — quit Leise, then replace the old `Leise.app` in your Applications folder. (First launch after replacing: System Settings → Privacy & Security → "Open Anyway", same as before — [README](https://github.com/ramonfeng/leise#readme).)
## What changed in 2.3.0
- **Leise Engine now polishes your words too.** Transcription and polishing both run under one name, entirely on your Mac. For polishing, Leise Engine uses your Mac's built-in intelligence when it can and its own bundled model otherwise — the switch is automatic, there is nothing to configure, and nothing ever leaves your Mac. Speech recognition is unchanged. - **First run is 2.1 GB lighter.** When your Mac's built-in intelligence handles polishing, Leise no longer downloads the additional polish model up front. If it is ever needed later — say the built-in intelligence becomes unavailable — Leise tells you in Settings and offers the download there, with a one-click button. - **The last sentences of a long dictation no longer disappear.** A sentence containing words you had already used could be mistaken for a duplicate re-delivery and dropped; the duplicate check now measures what is genuinely new, so repeated words no longer cost you the sentence around them. - **"Highlight but nothing happens" is fixed.** In some apps (Claude, Chrome-based editors) a polish could highlight the text but never deliver: Leise now waits out the moment where the app reports the selection before it is actually in place, instead of giving up on it. - **Dates come out in one script.** 「十月七日」 used to arrive as 「10月七日」 — month converted, day left in characters. Dates now convert as a whole (「10月7日」), whichever mixture the recognizer produced. - **No more 「，？」** — a stray comma in front of a question mark, occasionally added during polishing, is removed before anything reaches your cursor.
## The essentials (unchanged)
**Apple Silicon only** (M1 or newer) · **macOS 14.4+** (on-device polishing additionally needs a newer macOS with Apple Intelligence; without it Leise Engine uses its bundled model) · about **5–7 GB free disk** (app + speech models; 2.1 GB less when your Mac's built-in intelligence does the polishing).
A 100 % local dictation app for macOS. Your audio and your transcripts never leave your Mac; it works with the network off.
